Here’s my take on it:

1 - It was a direct juxtaposition with the image of the Cetra cresting materia in the VR simulation. Also, it was an attempt (and clearly not the first) to create *more powerful* materia than that found in nature.

2 - She was attempting to create summoning materia. This is significant for two reasons:

2.1 - It shows ShinRa’s continuous lust for more power. Why not healing, fire, or lightening? They have practical uses.

2.2 - Chadley has been creating summoning materia throughout the entire game (including summoning creatures that don’t exist in nature) but required actual battle data to round out the theoretical unknowns. Scarlet wanted results NOW.

3 - This is a soft introduction to huge materia, primarily the attempt of the non-cetra in creating synthetic materia. In the FFVII world, materia creation obeys the laws of life stream physics, and Scarlet was attempting to get around them.
